old_problem: `TEMP_INT_HSC` plausibly identifies one internal-temperature channel but cannot by itself establish all sensors for each hot-swap controller, input, protected load and channel. Exact revision-dependent voltage/current/power-good/fault/latch records were unspecified. Historical review retained an Engineering Decision for this OEM scope plus the 1/2/22 numbering gap.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. Complete read-only IPMI and Web collection is standard; the exact HSC controller/channel/input/load namespace, TEMP_INT_HSC role, scaling and normal/fault semantics are a versioned Project SPEC under ED-03/36. Missing configuration makes execution NOT READY, not review Pending. No active HSC gate/latch/feed/load operation is part of this sensor row. Written Criteria 1/2/22 remain intact and the numbering gap is not expanded into fictional coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2019, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2020 / Wistron-BMC-01040-V002 / 20b3c3467360d995.
IPMI inventories can be captured safely, but HSC revision, channel-to-input/load identity, electrical scaling and latch/fault semantics are OEM platform data.
Raw lists must precede TEMP_INT_HSC filtering so a signed namespace can determine whether it is complete, a thermal subset, an alias or missing and can require all companion records.
Active hot-swap control could interrupt a power path, so this row explicitly excludes HSC gate/latch, feed/load switching, threshold writes and fault injection.
The source contains SDR, Sensor List and Web obligations only; number 22 is a traceable editorial error and not authority for criteria 3–21.
No ipmitool, authentication, HSC/power sensor read, Web login/capture, gate/latch/feed/load action, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-HSC controller/channel/input/load sensor namespace parity across IB/OOB IPMI and Web
test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-SPEC-required passive HSC sensor for each exact controller/channel/input/protected-load path, including TEMP_INT_HSC and all required electrical/fault companions, across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web without controlling power.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/HSC board-controller part/revision/serial/location and channel/input/protected-load/redundancy map
Versioned HSC namespace defining TEMP_INT_HSC complete/partial scope plus voltage/current/power/power-good/fault/latch records, units/scaling/ranges/states/thresholds/freshness
Per-channel physical-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk and explicit N/A rules
Approved ipmitool, trusted protected OOB/Web access, aligned sampling plus load/cache/rounding/stale/unavailable/pagination rules
Passive overcurrent/voltage/power/thermal/fault/redundancy stop limits, evidence hashes, preserved logs and independent power recovery owner
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind exact HSC revision and controller/channel/input/load map, record stable power state and preserve logs. Capture complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`; retain raw data before applying the signed HSC namespace and TEMP_INT_HSC view. Capture every BMC Web Sensor page with controller/channel/load identity and time. Compare complete population and all name/description/type/unit/scaling/reading/state/threshold/freshness fields with SPEC and across views, using passive power-path context only. Never assume TEMP_INT_HSC is complete, query the testcase title, rely on grep/head alone, operate HSC gates/latches/feeds/loads, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every applicable HSC channel/input/load path has exactly its required passive records; TEMP_INT_HSC and companions bind correctly, all aligned IB/OOB/Web values/states conform to revision/load SPEC, power-path redundancy remains normal and no disallowed fault/thermal/log event appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact revision/topology/load state, complete raw IB/OOB and visual Web evidence, complete unique HSC namespace and every scaled field within SPEC/freshness rules. FAIL on unjustified temperature-only scope/N/A, missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed channel, wrong scaling/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, fault/redundancy alarm or incomplete evidence. Missing namespace/SPEC is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only only; prohibit HSC gate/latch control, feed/load switching, fault injection, threshold/BMC writes and log clearing.
Require exact revision/channel/load map and complete namespace after raw capture; use protected trusted access.
Stop on identity ambiguity, missing/duplicate map, overcurrent/voltage/power/temperature/fault alarm or redundancy loss.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, complete Web evidence and all power/BMC/host logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant plus SUT/BMC/HSC part-revision-serial/location and controller/channel/input/load topology
Complete HSC namespace with TEMP_INT_HSC scope, companion records, scaling/ranges and five-view crosswalk
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with HSC channel/load binding and pagination
Passive power/fault/redundancy/thermal context, numbering-defect/no-HSC-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong controller/channel, access, namespace, sensor/Web mismatch, power/fault/redundancy/thermal alarm or evidence failure, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not operate the HSC, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact channel/load and record IDs to power/BMC owners.
